title: Deliver the unified MIR 3 terminal .9 stabilization wave
migration_impact: Use immutable .5 releases as the only public predecessors; admit only defect correction, stabilization, archival, and MIR 4 handoff work; assign candidate identities only after exact source freeze; preserve stable public identities unless an admitted defect requires a governed migration; independently materialize and qualify every lower target; prohibit .6 through .8; and route feature or platform redesign to MIR 4.
release_note_impact: MIR 3.2.9 and the corresponding lower .9 releases are planned final MIR 3 stabilization releases. The .5 releases remain current until exact .9 candidates complete normal qualification and publication.

backport_disposition.factorio-2.1: implement admitted portable corrections canonically on dev and qualify 3.2.9 first
backport_disposition.factorio-2.0: project from exact portable 3.2.9 source onto immutable 2.5.5 with bounded adapters
backport_disposition.historical-targets: materialize each .9 directly from its immutable .5 predecessor plus the exact portable source; never use a lower-target waterfall
